values.en: Sign Convention for the Second Fundamental Form
values.zh-CN: 第二基本形式的符号约定

values.en: We use $\mathrm{II}(w,z)=-\langle d\boldsymbol N(w),z\rangle$, not its negative. In parameter notation $w=dX_q(\xi)$, the symbol $d\boldsymbol N(w)$ means $d(\boldsymbol N|_\Omega)_q(\xi)$; it does not apply the differential of a map on $\mathbb R^2$ directly to an ambient vector in $\mathbb R^3$. The equivalence with the coordinate definition is the normal-derivative property below. No shape operator is required.
values.zh-CN: 本文采用 $\mathrm{II}(w,z)=-\langle d\boldsymbol N(w),z\rangle$ 而非相反号。参数记号中若 $w=dX_q(\xi)$，则 $d\boldsymbol N(w)$ 是 $d(\boldsymbol N|_\Omega)_q(\xi)$ 的简记，绝不是把定义域为 $\mathbb R^2$ 的映射的微分直接作用于 $\mathbb R^3$ 中的向量。与坐标定义的等价性由下述法向微分性质说明；无需引入形算子。
